To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we designed an efficient hard attention-based model for classifying partial images, and the attention policy used in our model is explain- able and non-parametric.
we design an explainable visual hard attention model that can classify partially observed scenes.

(i) we design an explainable and nonparametric hard attention model that can be trained end-to-end using gradient descent and (ii) we show that our model performs better than baseline models on several image classification tasks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the explainability of hard attention.
the explainability of visual hard attention models and the design of efficient models to classify partially observable scenes.

the following questions: 1) What is a good attention model for partially observable scenes? 2) How can we make the attention policy used in a hard attention model explainable? 3) How can we train a hard attention model with a differentially optimized objective function?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed model is a hard attention model for image classification.
our model achieves comparable or better performance to other hard attention models while being explainable and nonparametric.
our proposed model is efficient and explainable.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed model is able to explain its attention policy by predicting the contents of the attended regions.
our model achieves explainability in a visual hard attention model through content prediction.
our model is a hard attention model which is efficient, non-parametric, differentiable and interpretable.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the EIG-based attention policy is explainable, and it can be learned in a supervised manner.
a model that predicts content of a region ahead of time, to estimate its EIG, is more efficient and explainable than the one that directly estimates EIG from the image.
a model can achieve explainability through content prediction.
